problem: P67 classical frequency/novelty rule used complete past-key history, violating claimed 256-float total state; repeated context query exact match made source easily soluble. Test memory parity with genuinely nonidentical views, simulated executed scalar action and measured vector consequence.

source.order: fresh uniform per-world interleave all 32 target events with novel distractors, no index/phase/role input
source.cause: each true role/prototype has one independently drawn tanh Gaussian 16-vector consequence per +1; each observed executed +/-1 action produces signed effect plus noise; unique distractor keys likewise
source.key: independent additive Gaussian view noise around per-world QR orthonormal prototype then normalize, never repeated exactly
source.query: new independently jittered view of uniformly randomly chosen target, plus a single actually executed +/-1 action and observed consequence. Query revealed only after entire factual history, never to write policies.
source.OOD_shift: different basis rotation, triple key jitter, double outcome noise, +32 novel distractors
source.index_role_leak_control: per-window quartile role deviation <.06 and heldout index-only balanced accuracy <=.56; otherwise no full study

frozen_model_controls.learned: exact original TTT fast 16x16 outer-product residual equation eta=.5 and 4 scalar theta on [1,log(residual_mse),log(previous_output_mean_square),cos(previous_output, actually observed action-normalized consequence)]; sigmoid gate, no time, query, source role; 256 persistent floats
frozen_model_controls.wrong_credit: same learned gate and setup, independent random +/-1 action identity substituted on historical facts, physical observed outcomes unmodified; query action and measured consequence identical
frozen_model_controls.all_write: original TTT matrix 256 floats always writes all completed facts
frozen_model_controls.fixed_surprise: original matrix 256 floats write only when residual below FIT+VAL calibrated threshold, no other memory
frozen_model_controls.fixed_novelty: original matrix 256 floats, write when ||previous read|| exceeds FIT+VAL calibrated threshold; no past-key archive
frozen_model_controls.proto8: classical 8 slots ×(16 observed-key floats +16 physical-effect floats)=256 persistent floats, key norm embeds capped visit count; similarity threshold chosen on VALIDATION only from [.60,.70,.80,.88]; online update matched slot and capped count or evict minimum count with lowest index tie. No out-of-band state/age/prototype identities. Same actual source as all others
frozen_model_controls.gru: conventional GRU 64 recurrent floats (less than 256 memory state) with 33-d [key,executed_action,actual_observed_outcome] event input, 16d effect head conditioned on query context and executed query action; train on same FIT factual query outcome, 300 AdamW steps; must report unconverged if not competent
frozen_model_controls.random: matrix Bernoulli gate with acceptance rate from learned FIT source only, per-model-seed PRNG; not equal compute but equal state
frozen_model_controls.oracle: uses hidden relevance/target role to skip distractors, ONLY privileged upper bound not fair control
frozen_model_controls.whole_history_knn: reference diagnostic over >256 floats, NEVER admissible capacity matched baseline

training.competence_threshold: GRU validation MSE <=0.85*zero-state validation MSE and final two checkpoints absolute MSE difference <=0.01; otherwise combined FAIL

scoring.primary: mean heldout actually executed query outcome 16D MSE on 128 never-trained synthetic OOD development worlds
scoring.strong_control: best lowest OOD MSE from original all-write, validation-calibrated fixed 256-float gates, 8-slot classical 256-float prototype, trained GRU (if competent)
strict_gates_every_seed: same total persistent state 256 floats for all admitted memory controls; GRU recurrent 64 floats
no arbitrary past-event index list for memory controls
candidate read-only query and exact tensor-only cold state reproduction
report: per-seed MSE, source SHA256, sample-index hash, train losses, parameter counts
runtime/final FLOP-parity status, no whole-system speed claim
exact source Git blobs, CUDA/Windows/WSL full regression UNVERIFIED if not run

meaning: Even if all development gates pass, this only supports further independent real-world causal source qualification; not scientific intelligence/architecture superiority.
